summary: Erase a former pool's backup credentials on join rehome and eject, keep one damaged receipt from disabling the rest, remove crashed-write temp files, raise the member credential pull bound, list receipts without the pool backup authority lock, and refuse an SMB3 username with '='. API impact: existing contract; payloads unchanged.

guide.reason: Operators see a partial backup-credentials check, credential erasure on join/eject and SMB3 username refusal.

api.reason: The Core report still carries redacted receipts and a backup-credentials check; receipts are now reported alongside a failed check when one file is damaged. The peer credential pull payload is unchanged; the member reads up to 32 MiB. No new route or field.

roadmap.reason: Defect fixes in the existing backup destination slice.

state.record: HMAC-protected private backup credential receipts under storage-cluster/secrets/backup and SMB3 mount credential files under backup-smb-credentials on each Core; a pool change now removes the former pool's records. A fresh Controller reads redacted receipts from the Core report.
state.reason: No Controller state is added; erasure runs in Core's own join rehome and eject re-initialization.

verification.method: Focused Go tests for the six regressions (and -race), red against the pre-fix sources via go test -overlay; related Credential/Join/Eject/Leave/Rehome/Receipt/SMB/Rotation/Promotion agent tests passed.
verification.limits: Simulated test stores only; no lab join/eject run. Stale SMB3 temp files in backup-smb-credentials are not swept at start (no lock covers that writer). Plaintext at rest is unchanged pending an owner decision.
